strings.en: I'll show you how scary I aaam!
I'll show you the power of/　the Dark Brain Army's top commander!
You destroyed Lord Dark Brain! Prepare yourself!
I'm the one who'll defeat you!
Roa, no matter what form you take,/　your fate is already sealed!
Roa, I don't have time for just you!
Small fry! Out of my way!
The way you talk makes me mad!
We meet at last, after 25 yeaaars!
Bufufu, too slow to escape, huh?
I'll let you go for today!
Do I have to use Wall now?!
Lord Dark Brain, lend me your power!
Not yet! I can take a beating!
Nngh... I won't let my glory slip away!
Roa! I won't lose to you!
The one who wins the Great Battle is me!
Not yet!/　The ones who win the great battle are us!
Take off that armor and fight me!
Wh-What is that sword of his?!
Pushed this far by a mere dragon!
Not as good as they say.
You'll need a lot more than that to beat me!
This world's Fighter Roar is annoying too!
Why does he talk just like that guy?
Transforming makes you feel big, huh?!
I'll snap that sword of yours in half!
What's that ring on your heaaad?!
I don't like that dragon's face!
With such a skinny little body...
I'll rip your wings off later!
You can hit me some more!
I let you hit me on purpose!
Roa, come at me ready to throw your life away!
Yep, the way you talk makes me mad!
So that's all a dragon's power amounts to!
Looks like lifting heavyweights isn't your thing!
You've lost your edge, Compati Kaiser!
I'll just bounce that right offff!
Can't fight on an empty stomaaach!
Nnngh, fled to the sidelines, have youuu?
I don't like it, but it can't be helpeeed.
You owe me one for thiiis.
If you go down here, it's all for nothiiing!
Serpent of light, finish them offff!
Guess I'll let those guys do the woooork.
Shall I use the Psycho Craniummm?
You've given me a lot of trouuuble!
I'll end this with GREAT sorcerrry!
